correctness.rationale: An invariant finite configuration has identical positive radial point sets on all arms of each nontrivial H-orbit. The number of radii in such an orbit is locally constant because simultaneous collisions of two or more distinct points at the center are forbidden. Restriction to the f fixed arms and reassembly from the radial lists are inverse continuous maps on clopen strata, proving the homeomorphism for every finite H and k>=0. Every radius list simplex is convex. The ordinary radial-star theorem gives connected graph homotopy and the exact rank; the two rational series follow by an independently verified binomial identity. The f=0 and k=0 boundaries are explicitly treated. Graph-spine enumeration: 245 cases, 7504 fixed vertices, 13119 fixed edges, 510 components, total Betti1 6125; finite tests corroborate but are not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural complete topology classification for all unordered collision-free particle counts and all arm-permutation subgroups of any finite star, including nontransitive and fixed-arm-free actions. The orbit-size multiset completely determines fixed-space homeomorphism type, component counts, first integral Betti numbers, and vanishing of higher homology, by rational generating functions. Nontrivial mixed-type example: five arms, one transposition, four particles gives three components of circle ranks 6,1,0. Unlike characters or quotients, these data describe the actual invariant collision-free motion space. Scope is motivated by symmetric robot/particle motion on networks, not an artificial parameter slice.
